info.title: NugetAudit.Cli
info.description: Audits NuGet package trust by verifying nuget.org prefix reservation and surfacing publisher trust signals: newly published versions, deprecations, vulnerabilities, and executable content. A single CI gate for zero-trust dependency management.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: NuGet package security audit tool for .NET solutions.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Run a NuGet package security audit.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the solution, project, or directory to audit. [default: .]

options.name: --all
options.description: Show all packages, not just those needing review. [default: False]

options.name: --package-list
options.description: Output as a grouped package list for copy-pasting into TrustConfig.json. [default: False]

options.name: --include-existing
options.description: Include existing trusted packages in the output (use with --package-list). [default: False]

options.name: --check
options.description: Exit with code 1 if any packages need review, are deprecated, have vulnerabilities, or if security advisories are present (missing lock file, RestoreLockedMode, pre-build target, or Package Source Mapping). [default: False]

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: table, csv, or json. [default: table]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write output to the specified file. Requires --format csv or --format json.

options.name: --trust-config
options.description: Path to TrustConfig.json, or a directory containing it. Defaults to the solution directory.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show full output without condensing: all transitive packages, all recently-published entries. [default: False]

commands.name: preview-update
commands.description: Preview the dependency graph impact of adding or updating a NuGet package.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the solution, project, or directory. [default: .]

options.name: --version
options.description: Target version. Omit to resolve to the latest stable version.

options.name: --trust-config
options.description: Path to TrustConfig.json, or a directory containing it. Defaults to the solution directory.

options.name: --fast
options.description: Use the approximate BFS resolver instead of running dotnet restore. Faster but may not match the actual restore graph. Not recommended for security-critical decisions. [default: False]

arguments.name: PACKAGE_ID
arguments.description: The NuGet package identifier to add or update.

commands.name: preview-restore

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the project, solution, or directory. [default: .]

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework moniker (TFM) for dependency resolution. Auto-detected from the project file when omitted.

options.name: --trust-config
options.description: Path to TrustConfig.json, or a directory containing it. Defaults to the solution directory.

options.name: --fast
options.description: Use the approximate BFS resolver instead of running dotnet restore. Faster but may not match the actual restore graph. Not recommended for security-critical decisions. [default: False]
